reason: A DSH web UI plugin that replaces the built-in plugin inventory with a Chinese interface for categorized browsing, search, descriptions, and third-party plugin enable/disable controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件列表提供中文说明、分类分组、搜索以及第三方插件启停管理界面。
summaries.en: Adds a Chinese-localized DeepSeek Harness plugin inventory with categorization, search, descriptions, and controls for enabling or disabling third-party plugins.

capabilities: Adds a Chinese-localized plugin inventory panel with grouping, search, descriptions, and status indicators
Allows enabling or disabling third-party plugins through a local API route and managed configuration updates
Disables the built-in read-only plugin inventory panel to provide the replacement interface
